piece.caption: How to use Google Gemini Live on low RAM Android budget phones for field staff. Aapko apne shop workers ya site staff ke liye expensive phones lene ki zaroorat nahi hai. Google ne Gemini app ko Android Go devices aur lower-memory phones ke liye re-architect kar diya hai. Ab aapke staff typing ke bina 45 se zyada bhashaon mein Gemini Live se baat kar sakte hain aur notes ko translate kar sakte hain. Iske liye sirf Play Store se app download karna hai ya power button long press karna hai. Comment GEMINI for step-by-step setup guide.

claims.claim: The Gemini app is now available on lower-memory Android devices, including Android Go edition devices.
Google re-architected the Gemini app so the core experience runs smoothly on hardware with less memory.
Users can talk out loud in more than 45 languages with Gemini Live.
Users can point their camera at notes or forms to learn and translate.
To get started, users can download Gemini on Google Play or press and hold the power button on supported phones.

piece.dm_text: Budget Android phones par Google Gemini setup karne ke steps: 1. Google Play Store se Gemini app download karein. 2. Supported Android Go devices par power button hold karke bhi activate kar sakte hain. 3. App open karke Gemini Live se 45+ languages mein voice talk karein. 4. Notes ya forms translate karne ke liye camera feature use karein. Note: Core Gemini functions light hardware par smoothly chalte hain, lekin active internet connection zaroori hai. Official Google blog link: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-app/gemini-lower-memory-devices/

[32] Google AI Blog — The Gemini app is now available on lower-memory Android devices.
URL: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/products/gemini-app/gemini-lower-memory-devices/
The Gemini app is now available on lower-memory Android devices. Angus Logan
For hundreds of millions of people globally, a lower-memory Android device is their everyday connection to the internet, education, and business.
Until recently, hardware limits meant those phones only had basic voice commands. Now, we’re bringing the Gemini app to eligible Android (Go edition) devices , putting Google’s personal AI assistant in the hands of hundreds of millions more people. We re-architected the app so the core Gemini experience runs smoothly on hardware with less memory.
Instead of typing out long prompts, you can talk things through or practice for an interview out loud in more than 45 languages with Gemini Live , point your camera at notes or forms to learn and translate, or create custom images with Nano Banana — like a flyer for a weekend bakery sale. To get started, download the Gemini app on Google Play, press and hold the power button on supported phones, or look for it preloaded on upcoming devices from partners like Transsion.
